output.patientMessage: You can manage this at home for now; over-the-counter itch remedies from your pharmacist are a reasonable start for a poison ivy rash limited to your forearms. Contact a Counsel clinician in this thread if the rash spreads well beyond your forearms, involves your face or genitals, becomes very painful, or shows pus, increasing redness or fever. Seek emergency care right away for facial or throat swelling or trouble breathing.
